column2:
My friend — we have drawn close to the forest:
2	the dreams are close pressed; the battle is quick.
3	You are gazing at the terror-radiances of the god,
4	of Huwawa, at whom your heart keeps taking fright.
5	But you will lock horns and, like a champion bull, batter him;
6	you will bend his head down by your main strength —
7	and the old one you saw is your masterful god,
8	the maker of your frame, Lugalbanda.
